as_told.title: Intelligence calls to Bill Moore after the Roswell book tour

plain: This story is about Bill Moore, a writer who in 1980 was touring to promote his book The Roswell Incident, about a claimed UFO crash in New Mexico. A researcher, Greg Bishop, relays what Moore said: at radio stations on the tour, a mysterious voice kept calling him. When he reached Albuquerque and went into the radio station, the same voice called again. Bishop says this led Moore to meet a man named Rick Doty and an insider known only as Falcon, and he also names Harry Rositzke. Another researcher, Grant Cameron, says the first call came seven days into the tour and was probably from Doty in Albuquerque. It is linked to another story about a security meeting at Kirtland Air Force Base. If true, it would mean people inside the government were reaching out to steer UFO researchers.
